review: The hymn is the beauty of the Redeemer: 1:1–4 is Ps 45:3 with Ps 21:6 and Rev 19:12, 2:1–4 is Ps 45:3 with Luke 4:22 and Phil 2:9, 3:1–4 is 1 Tim 2:6 (כֹּפֶר) with Isa 53:6, and 4:1–4 is Ps 73:24 with Ps 16:2.

2:2 עַל־שְׂפָתָיו הַמְּאִירוֹת — the Arabic فِي ثَغْرِهِ الْمُنِير is 'on his radiant mouth'; the Hebrew uses שָׂפָה, the word of Song 4:3 and Isa 6:5, and puts the light on the lips rather than on the mouth's opening, because the line is about the grace that is heard.

3:1 לְכֹפֶר — the glossary's כֹּפֶר (the covering price of Exod 21:30) is kept rather than the more general פִּדְיוֹן, since the stanza moves straight to the bearing of sin and the line needs the sacrificial word.
